description: This file is a startup script for a frontend development environment, primarily responsible for detecting if the environment is a Continuous Integration (CI) environment and redirecting to a static server to avoid termination issues during CI, or starting the development server locally. It manages environment variables related to hosting, port, source maps, and memory settings, and executes appropriate commands to initiate either a static build or a development server.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects if the current environment is a CI environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with inherited stdio and specified environment, then exits the process with the command's status code.
